normalized.description:
The S5C maintenance workshop no longer meets the functional needs and ergonomic, technical, or safety requirements of the activities carried out there.

It is composed of two enclosed, air-conditioned spaces used for storing small electrical and mechanical equipment, maintenance operations and training new staff.

It also consists of a semi-open space that is the heart of mechanical maintenance activities, particularly for work on equipment related to payloads. It contains fixed machine tools, workbenches, and several storage cabinets.

Finally, above these two areas, there is an open space for storing furniture and bulky equipment.

It is therefore necessary to redesign these three areas of the workshop in order to respond more effectively and efficiently to electrical and mechanical maintenance needs, the training of new operators, and the storage of equipment on the upper floor, which we wish to close in an air-conditioned environment.
